parts.note_add: The catalogue's numerical index (S-005 Body-Index p.156) also prints the right panel as 8981-58-020E, so the figure and the index agree; the 8871 pattern remains unconfirmed. No new or reproduction outer door skin found; used doors only.

Removal per the 1985 manual (S-002 sec.14 p.14-9): regulator handle, inner handle cover, arm rest, trim, inner handle, watershield, then the glass-to-regulator screws and grommets. New glass not found; used glass through salvage listings only.

Mazda has discontinued the channel seal 8871-58-605C; Atkins Rotary makes a reproduction (USD 84 each, one per side, fits either side, 2026-09-26). Guides A (8871-58-603 / -59-603) not found for sale.
Still genuine Mazda: Atkins Rotary lists R 8871-58-760 and L 8871-59-760 at USD 107 each, in stock 2026-09-26; dealer sites (Tasca, RealMazdaParts) also list both numbers.
No new 79-85 hinges found (Atkins' hinge category lists only the 86-88 lower left); used OEM lower right sold by Autopart3 (USD 95, 2026-09-26).

Catalogue (S-005 p.69) gives 8871-58-310E / -59-310E for '81 and '82 models, FQ23-58-310 / -59-310 for '83. The 1985 manual (S-002 sec.14 p.14-11) says to fit a new outer-handle nylon bush (1243-58-411) whenever the lock is reinstalled and to adjust the inner handle for play. No new latch found; used only.
Adjustable in-and-out and up-and-down by loosening its attaching screws (S-002 sec.14 p.14-9). 8531-58-361 not found for sale new; Atkins lists only the 86-91 and 93-95 strikers.
Used only (Known Motors, USD 15, sold out 2026-09-26); no new 8545-58-330 found.

Atkins Rotary stocks 8116-58-303 in black and tan (USD 18, fits either side); red and grey no longer available. Mazdatrix sells a machined aluminium black pair (8116-58-303-AL, USD 45) and lists the Mazda colours as discontinued. A free printable cup (cad row) also exists.

Genuine handles still sold: Atkins Rotary USD 97 (listed under 8871-59-410C, says it fits either side: check against the R/L catalogue numbers); Amazon and eBay sellers offer the 8871-58-410C / -59-410C pair, which is shared with the 1981-84 B2000/B2200 pickup. Fit a new nylon bushing 1243-58-411 when the lock is reinstalled (S-002 sec.14 p.14-11).

Genuine manual regulators still sold by Atkins Rotary (USD 210, driver or passenger side, 2026-09-26). Catalogue (S-005 p.69): 8871-58-560A / -59-560A are the S and GS manual units, FA02-58-560 / -59-560 the GSL power units. Adjustment (S-002 sec.14 p.14-10): glass raised fully, horizontal by moving the regulator guide, fore-and-aft by the glass-guide adjusting bolt.

Atkins Rotary lists 8038-58-580A in red (-11) and brown (-72) as no longer available and grey (-65, 84-85) out of stock (USD 35, 2026-09-26); Mazdatrix lists the red one. Catalogue figure p.69 prints the number as 8036-58-580A but the index p.156 reads 8038-58-580A.

The left hinge number resolves: the catalogue's numerical index (S-005 Body-Index p.157) prints 8871-63-210B against figure 6230A-1, and Atkins Rotary lists 8871-63-210B (left) and 8871-62-210B (right) at USD 65 each, both out of stock 2026-09-26. Alignment (S-002 sec.14 p.14-12): weatherstrip top, headlining rear end and rear header pads off, then loosen the hinge nuts with the hatch closed.

The 1985 manual's figure of this lock (S-002 sec.14 p.14-12, fig 47U14X-034) shows a switch built into the lock body with contact points A and B beside the key cylinder; the lock is adjusted to the striker by loosening its attaching bolts. rx7club: 1981-85 GS/GSL use the power latch FA01-62-310, S models the manual FA02-62-310; 1979-80 latches have a different bolt spacing and do not swap. No new latch found.
8871-62-361 is the same striker loop for all 1979-85 cars (rx7club hatch-latch thread); the lock, not the striker, is moved to align (S-002 sec.14 p.14-12).

Catalogue (S-005 p.92): S and GS cars take 8341-89-621 x2; the GSL right stay is 1482-89-621 (carries the rear wiper/defroster wiring). Atkins Rotary sells 1482-89-621 as '79-85 Rx7 Rear Hatch Strut' (USD 30, in stock); aftermarket StrongArm 4709 and TRW TSG127001 (USD 12.40) fit 79-85. The 1985 manual: never disassemble the stay, and drill a 2-3 mm hole at the cylinder's lower end to vent it before discarding (S-002 sec.14 p.14-12).

Bonded-in glass: removal and fitting follow the windshield method (S-002 sec.14 p.14-22: garnish and glass plate screw off, rear pillar trim, glass nut, damper stay end off, then saw the sealant with piano wire). No new glass found; Plastics4Performance makes pre-curved Lexan polycarbonate replacements (3/4/5 mm, made to order, UK) and salvage listings carry used glass.
Atkins Rotary lists FA01-51-881A (R) and FA01-51-891A (L) as no longer available (2026-09-26).
